stdio_review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: Each group is an independent coefficient in GF(5), since choosing 0..4 copies is exactly one field element. Build a normalized echelon basis of the group vectors; every reachable query has 5^(n-rank) coefficient solutions and unreachable queries have zero. Pack each coordinate in a four-bit integer lane for exact parallel field arithmetic. Adding two field elements gives 0..8 without cross-lane carry; identify lanes >=5 by bit predicates, then subtract 5 in precisely those lanes. Precompute negative scalar multiples for each normalized pivot, so elimination uses a few Python big-integer operations rather than scalar O(m) loops. No random hashing or approximate rank decisions.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
